subtests.name: default AudioContext.sinkId should be the empty string.
setSinkId() with a valid device identifier and setting the same ID should succeed.
setSinkId() with AudioSinkOptions.type of "none" and setting the same option should succeed.
setSinkId() should fail with TypeError on an invalid AudioSinkOptions.type value.
setSinkId() should fail with NotFoundError on an invalid device identifier.
setSinkId() should fail with InvalidStateError when calling from a stopped AudioContext.
setSinkId() should fail with InvalidStateError when calling from a detached document.
pending setSinkId() should be rejected with InvalidStateError when AudioContext is closed.
